Struct-TCS: TCR + MHC tokens + TCR residue graph (Cβ–Cβ ≤ 8 Å; Cα for Gly)
AngleNet: TCR + MHC tokens; FR4 rows (IMGT 118–124) padded

TEIM-Res: element-wise outer product → 1 × 1 conv → 3 dilated 2D residual blocks (dilation 1, 2, 4)

TCR-IMAP (pairwise): bilinear s·⟨W_t h_i, W_m g_j⟩/√d + P_ij + b (P 75 × 84, init 0; s init 1; b init −4)
BCE, positive-class weight = neg/pos (resolved training pairs), masked to resolved pairs
AngleNet: smooth L1 on the standardized angle

TCR-IMAP (per-residue): cluster-disjoint validation (whole clu70 clusters, ≥ 15 % of training complexes); AUPRC every 5 epochs; stop after 10 evaluations without improvement; best weights restored
